notes.title: Get Ready for Rise of Shrooms
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452209/f5f2cdb8546f9d18d4c0eebdd4d7e97982271ea4.png

Hello!

We at Miluku Inc. are thrilled to welcome you to our newest game—Rise of Shrooms! Whether you’re a new player or a fan of Shokudo Underworld, you’re in for a treat. If you’re reading this, consider yourself lucky, because Rise of Shrooms is a strategy game that’s so fun, you won’t be able to put it down!

With adorable characters, a variety of weapons and wacky spells, and plenty of strategic challenges, this game will charm you while keeping your brain hard at work.

What is Rise of Shrooms?
You’ll start with three default mushroom warriors, each with unique abilities. Every round, you roll the dice and use the points you get to plan your characters’ actions. As you progress, you can gather resources, craft upgrades, and enhance your abilities to survive the increasingly difficult battles.

Your ultimate goal? Defeat monsters, open portals, and conquer new islands! But be warned—the journey won’t be easy. Besides the countless enemies along the way, a massive boss awaits you at the end. Think you can handle it?

The more you play, the more items you unlock and the more realms you explore, bringing even greater challenges and surprises!

Try the Demo on February 24!
To bring you the best gaming experience, we’re launching a demo on February 24 as part of Steam Next Fest. We’d love to hear your feedback to help us improve the game before release!

So, what are you waiting for? Mark your calendar, wishlist the game, and follow us on social media to stay updated on all the latest news!

See you in Rise of Shrooms! 🍄✨

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3344870/Rise_of_Shrooms/
